name: Wireless Access
description:
a. Establish configuration requirements, connection requirements, and implementation guidance for each type of wireless access; and
b. Authorize each type of wireless access to the system prior to allowing such connections.
supplemental_guidance: Wireless technologies include microwave, packet radio (ultra-high frequency or very high frequency), 802.11x, and Bluetooth. Wireless networks use authentication protocols that provide authenticator protection and mutual authentication.

enhancements.name: Authentication and Encryption
enhancements.statement: Protect wireless access to the system using authentication of [Selection (one or more): users; devices] and encryption.

enhancements.name: Disable Wireless Networking
enhancements.statement: Disable, when not intended for use, wireless networking capabilities embedded within system components prior to issuance and deployment.

enhancements.name: Restrict Configurations by Users
enhancements.statement: Identify and explicitly authorize users allowed to independently configure wireless networking capabilities.

enhancements.name: Antennas and Transmission Power Levels
enhancements.statement: Select radio antennas and calibrate transmission power levels to reduce the probability that signals from wireless access points can be received outside of organization-controlled boundaries.
